claim: GuardDuty retains generated findings for 90 days and exports active findings to Amazon EventBridge; you can optionally export generated findings to an Amazon S3 bucket to track historical data.

evidence.quote: GuardDuty retains the generated findings for a period of 90 days. GuardDuty exports the active findings to Amazon EventBridge (EventBridge). You can optionally export the generated findings to an Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket. This will help you to track the historical data of potentially suspicious activities in your account and evaluate whether the recommended remediation steps were successful.

qualifiers.condition: export settings are configured per Region

values.display: exports the active findings to Amazon EventBridge
